title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. For the first face, draw a two-dimensional sketch that consists of a single loop. Start by drawing the first arc from the point (0.0, 0.0023) to (0.0007, 0.0007) and ending at (0.0023, 0.0). Next, draw the first line from (0.0023, 0.0) to (0.0117, 0.0). Follow this with the second arc from (0.0117, 0.0) to (0.0134, 0.0007) and ending at (0.0141, 0.0023). Draw the second line from (0.0141, 0.0023) to (0.0141, 0.0117). Continue with the third arc from (0.0141, 0.0117) to (0.0134, 0.0134) and ending at (0.0117, 0.0141). Draw the third line from (0.0117, 0.0141) to (0.0023, 0.0141). Finally, draw the fourth arc from (0.0023, 0.0141) to (0.0007, 0.0134) and ending at (0.0, 0.0117). Complete the loop with the fourth line from (0.0, 0.0117) to (0.0, 0.0023). Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.0141. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three-dimensional space using the previously defined Euler angles and translation vector. Extrude the two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units without extruding in the opposite direction. This operation will create a new solid body with a length of 0.0140625 units, a width of 0.0140625 units, and a height of 0.75 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0, 0)

# Create the arcs and lines
sketch = sketch.moveTo(0.0, 0.0023).threePointArc((0.0007, 0.0007), (0.0023, 0.0))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0117, 0.0)
sketch = sketch.threePointArc((0.0134, 0.0007), (0.0141, 0.0023))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0141, 0.0117)
sketch = sketch.threePointArc((0.0134, 0.0134), (0.0117, 0.0141))
sketch = sketch.lineTo(0.0023, 0.0141)
sketch = sketch.threePointArc((0.0007, 0.0134), (0.0, 0.0117))
sketch = sketch.close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = sketch.extrude(0.75)

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# A long square bar with rounded corners, based on the bounding box
# X 0.0141, Y 0.0141, Z 0.7500

w = 0.0141        # square cross-section width
length = 0.75     # bar length (Z)
fr = 0.002        # corner fillet radius seen in the views

# Sketch the rounded-square cross-section
r = cq.Workplane("XY") \
    .moveTo(0.0, fr) \
    .threePointArc((fr * 0.3, fr * 0.3), (fr, 0.0)) \
    .lineTo(w - fr, 0.0) \
    .threePointArc((w - fr * 0.3, fr * 0.3), (w, fr)) \
    .lineTo(w, w - fr) \
    .threePointArc((w - fr * 0.3, w - fr * 0.3), (w - fr, w)) \
    .lineTo(fr, w) \
    .threePointArc((fr * 0.3, w - fr * 0.3), (0.0, w - fr)) \
    .close() \
    .extrude(length)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
